verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is fundamentally an SSH/mosh terminal client, so a developer could SSH into a remote host and run any terminal-based editor (vim, nano) or linter there, but there is no evidence of a built-in local editor or lint/syntax-check tooling inside Blink itself — the docs only list basic file commands (cat, grep, ls, etc.) and integration with external VS Code servers rather than an in-app editor.
